name: Maple & pomegranate caramelized chicken-bulgur meatballs (קציצות עוף ובורגול מקורמלות במייפל ורימונים)

source.author: Instagram reel — "my mom's meatballs" (family recipe shared on IG)
source.notes: Analyzed from the pasted Hebrew caption (full ingredient list + method). The Reel video itself was not fetched — the caption is self-sufficient. Herb/onion/garlic weights estimated; oil and sweeteners measured by volume.

serving_desc: ≈4 flat patties (~200 g) — batch is large (1 kg meat); scale if you portion differently

ingredients.note: 500 g ground chicken + 500 g ground pargit (thigh)

ingredients.qty: 1 cup dry (~140 g), soaked 30 min & drained

steps: Mix all meatball ingredients until uniform; cover and chill 20–30 min.
Sear on a lightly oiled grill pan over medium heat until browned both sides.
In a wide pan, combine sauce maple + pomegranate molasses + water; bring to a gentle boil.
Add the meatballs, roll gently to coat, and cook a few minutes until the sauce reduces, thickens and caramelizes them.
Serve with white rice / mash / couscous; top with fresh herbs or pomegranate seeds.

him.verdict: Excellent protein density (~5.6 g protein per 100 kcal) from the lean poultry + bulgur, and real whole-grain fiber. But the ⅓ cup olive oil, THREE in-mix sweeteners (honey + silan + maple) plus a maple/pomegranate sauce push it to a calorie-dense, sugar-heavy (~19 g added sugar/serving) meal — the weak spot on a cut. Sodium is very high (~900 mg/serving from 1 tbsp salt). A 6 as written; an easy 8 with the trims below.
suggested_mods: Cut olive oil from ⅓ cup to ~2 tbsp — lean poultry doesn't need it (saves ~350 kcal / ~40 g fat across the batch)
Drop the three in-mix sweeteners (honey/silan/maple); keep only the sauce for the caramel effect — halves the added sugar
Cut salt from 1 tbsp to ~1.5 tsp — 900 mg sodium/serving is a lot for one dish
Serve over cauliflower rice or a big salad instead of white rice to hold the deficit and add fiber/lycopene/vitamin C
Finish with pomegranate seeds (the garnish) — genuine vitamin C + polyphenols, sperm-friendly

her_preconception.verdict: Solid preconception base — lean poultry protein plus iron (~1.7 mg), choline (~55 mg), zinc, and bulgur's whole-grain folate/fiber. Folate is only modest as-is but trivially boosted with more herbs / a legume side. Naturally pairs iron with the pomegranate's vitamin C (better non-heme absorption). No unsafe ingredients — just cook the ground poultry through.
prenatal_highlights: iron from the poultry + bulgur, paired with pomegranate vitamin C for absorption
whole-grain folate + fiber from the bulgur
parsley/cilantro add folate — stir some in fresh at the end, not only cooked

safety_advisories.note: Ground poultry must be cooked fully through (no pink, ~74°C internal) — standard for meatballs, just don't undercook the centers.
High sodium (~900 mg/serving) — worth easing during pregnancy (BP/edema).

suggested_mods: Double the fresh herbs and fold half in raw at the end for more folate
Serve with a lentil or leafy-green side — adds folate + iron, and the pomegranate's vitamin C boosts absorption
